verdict.rationale: Attio documents a visual Workflows builder and SDK-based custom workflow blocks. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for those automations. SDK apps being code (and so trackable in a user's own source control) is a developer building block and user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
